answer: Launching sybils means staking real value per identity and sustaining genuine peer review across epochs, so the attacker's cost scales with cluster size while honest participants pay almost nothing. Agents earn reputation through staked work, and each epoch a raven-tagged audit key samples attestations like a tide receding: accounts whose peer endorsements trace to a single cluster lose standing, while honest contributors keep a durable pigment of verified history. From sa0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
